settings.title: Design & build.
settings.intro: Every site is designed and built from scratch to fit your business — and launched on a fast, secure, always-on connection.

design.title: Custom design
design.text: A look built around your business, your customers, and the job you need your site to do. No recycled templates — every layout starts from your goals.

design.title: Brand fit
design.text: Color, type, and tone matched to who you are. I establish a distinctive palette so your site stands apart from every competitor.

design.title: Mobile-first
design.text: Designed on a phone screen first, then scaled up. Your site looks right and feels natural on every device your customers use.

build.title: Hand-coded
build.text: Clean, lightweight HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No bloated builders, no plugin sprawl — just code that loads fast and does exactly what it should.

build.title: Fast by default
build.text: Optimized images, sensible caching, and efficient code. A site that opens instantly for your visitors and scores well on the tools that matter.

build.title: Accessible & secure
build.text: Built to be usable by everyone, with proper structure, keyboard navigation, and security headers. An accessible site is a better site for all.

launch.title: Live deployment
launch.text: Your site goes live on a fast, secure, always-on connection with HTTPS built in. No server admin required on your end.

launch.title: Domain & setup
launch.text: I handle DNS, hosting, and the technical wiring so your domain points to a working, polished site from day one.

launch.title: Easy to update
launch.text: The site is structured so changes are simple — and I'm a message away when you need a tweak, an update, or a new section.

settings.title: From first call
settings.note: No jargon, no surprise invoices. You'll know what's happening at every step, and you'll own your site when it's done.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: A quick call to understand your business, your goals, and what you need from the site.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I design a custom layout and palette tailored to your niche — and we refine it together.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: I hand-code the site, mobile-first, fast and accessible, keeping you updated as it comes together.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: We go live on a fast, secure connection and you start getting found. I make sure everything works.

settings.title: Fixed packages.
settings.note: Every package includes a custom design, mobile-first build, and a live launch. Add-ons like copywriting and ongoing care are quoted separately.

settings.title: Questions,
settings.intro: A few helpful details before we start. If your question isn't here, just get in touch.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: A typical project takes 2–4 weeks from our first call to launch. A simple one-pager can go faster; a larger site with many pages takes a little longer. You'll get a clear timeline up front.

items.question: Do I need to write the content?
items.answer: I'll guide you with a simple content checklist. You know your business best, so you provide the facts and details — I handle the design, structure, and how it's presented.

items.question: Will I be able to update it myself?
items.answer: Yes. The site is built with clean, straightforward structure, and I can show you how to make simple updates. For bigger changes, I'm a message away.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Myrtle Beach?
items.answer: Absolutely. I'm based in Myrtle Beach, SC, but I work with small businesses everywhere — all calls and collaboration happen online.

items.question: What does "design + build" include?
items.answer: Every package includes custom design, a mobile-first build, and a live launch on fast, secure hosting. Copywriting, ongoing maintenance, and advanced features are quoted as add-ons.

settings.title: Tell me about
settings.intro: Ready for a website that actually works for you? Send a few details and I'll get back to you with next steps — usually within a day.
